 3  description: Turn internal meeting transcripts of up to 60 minutes into concise decisions and action items with evidence locations.

 5  # Meeting minutes
 6  
 7  Use an actual transcript, agenda or supplied notes. If only audio exists, first use audio-transcription within its actual supported runtime limits; the audio must also fit the source-size and codec limits documented by that runtime.
 8  
 9  Record available meeting metadata, attendees and source identity. Missing details are Unknown; ask only for information that materially blocks the requested result. Draft from evidence using references/template.md: summary, decisions, action items, unresolved questions and source references. A suggestion is not an approved decision. A mentioned person is not automatically an action owner. Unknown owners and dates remain Unknown. Each decision/action links to its original quote, segment or actual time range; do not invent word-level timestamps.
10  
11  Keep short meetings concise. Review every significant claim against source text; label corrections or ambiguity. Produce the requested Markdown/Word/PDF using existing file and Office capabilities. Open/render actual files before publication. Use wx_artifact_publish and wait for existing writeback. Publishing a file here does not authorize external distribution, emails or creating tasks; those require separate user intent and actual tools.
12  
13  Read references/upstream.md for adaptation and scope. No automatic sharing, ASR engine or new task system is included.

1  # Minutes template
 2  
 3  Title / date / duration / organizer / attendees: factual values or Unknown.
 4  Source: attachment identity, original hash or supplied notes; state missing evidence.
 5  
 6  ## Summary
 7  Meeting objective and supported outcome in one short paragraph.
 8  
 9  ## Decisions
10  Decision; approving person/group if explicit; rationale; original quote and segment/range. Clearly distinguish proposed and confirmed decisions.
11  
12  ## Action items
13  Action; owner or Unknown; due date or Unknown; acceptance criterion if explicit; evidence location. Do not silently turn a discussion topic into an assigned task.
14  
15  ## Agenda notes and unresolved questions
16  Brief factual notes, blockers and questions. Suggested next steps must be labelled suggestions.
17  
18  ## References and revision
19  Actual sources only, draft revision and substantive corrections. For ≤30-minute meetings aim for about one page; for ≤60-minute meetings about two pages when content permits. Layout preferences never justify dropping important decisions.
